## Summary
Describe the problem and the focused change.

## Related issue
Closes #

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation

## Validation
- [ ] I tested this on a disposable WordPress installation or explain why not.
- [ ] Relevant automated tests pass.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] I updated documentation and version notes where needed.
- [ ] I checked input sanitization, output escaping, nonces and capability checks.
- [ ] I did not add telemetry, tracking or external network calls.

## Screenshots / notes
Add screenshots for user-facing changes. Remove customer data and credentials.
